# Theme System Overhaul Plan (Color Only)

**Generated by Agent B1 (Audit) — Updated upon Final Implementation**
**Date:** 2026-11-22  
**Branch:** dev/theme-audit  
**Status:** IMPLEMENTED — Phases 1–4 Complete

## 1. Complete Token Inventory

### 1.1 StoreSettings Model (10 Fields — Source of Truth)

All 10 color fields in `catalog/models.py` validate `#rrggbb` via `_validate_hex_color`, include `help_text` linking to their CSS token name (migration `0003_alter_storesettings_dark_color_accent_and_more.py` generated and ready to apply to remote Supabase via `uv run python manage.py migrate`), and remain intact for both light and dark themes.

| Field | Default (Light) | Default (Dark) | Semantic Role |
|-------|-----------------|----------------|---------------|
| `light_color_primary` / `dark_color_primary` | `#30669c` | `#39f2f9` | Brand primary — buttons, links, active states |
| `light_color_secondary` / `dark_color_secondary` | `#08121b` | `#e0ebe7` | Body text, headings, high-contrast text |
| `light_color_accent` / `dark_color_accent` | `#e0801f` | `#e7994b` | CTAs, highlights, focus rings, decorative accents |
| `light_color_background` / `dark_color_background` | `#f6f1ee` | `#08121b` | Page background, card backgrounds |
| `light_color_surface` / `dark_color_surface` | `#ffffff` | `#0c1927` | Elevated surfaces (cards, modals, dropdowns) |

### 1.2 Tailwind v4 `@theme` & Source Configuration (`static/css/input.css`)

Tailwind v4 scanning is restricted via `@import "tailwindcss" source(none);` with explicit `@source "../../templates";` and `@source "../../static/js";` directives so markdown files under `docs/` never leak junk utilities (such as `.bg-\[\#\.\.\.\]`) into `static/css/output.css`.

| Category | Tokens | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **Core Color Tokens (5 light defaults)** | `--color-primary` (`#30669c`), `--color-secondary` (`#08121b`), `--color-accent` (`#e0801f`), `--color-background` (`#f6f1ee`), `--color-surface` (`#ffffff`) | Match `StoreSettings` defaults; overridden at runtime via `theme-variables.html` |
| **Semantic Aliases (7)** | `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-border`, `--color-border-strong`, `--color-focus`, `--color-focus-ring`, `--color-overlay` | Derived from core tokens via `var(...)` / `color-mix(...)` |
| **Status Colors (4)** | `--color-success` (`#10b981`), `--color-warning` (`#f59e0b`), `--color-error` (`#ef4444`), `--color-info` (`#3b82f6`) | Fixed semantic alert colors (not admin-editable) |
| **Brand Tokens (6 + utility)** | `--color-whatsapp` (`#25d366`), `--color-instagram` (`#e1306c`), `--color-instagram-start` (`#f58529`), `--color-instagram-mid` (`#dd2a7b`), `--color-instagram-end` (`#8134af`), `--color-tiktok` (`#010101`), plus `@utility bg-instagram-gradient` | Powers WhatsApp CTAs, prominent Instagram funnel pill, and TikTok social link |
| **Rose Palette (10 shades)** | `--color-rose-50` through `--color-rose-950` | Kept for wishlist/favorites UI |
| **Font Tokens (3)** | `--font-tajawal`, `--font-cairo`, `--font-el-messiri` | Kept |

### 1.3 CSS Custom Properties (`templates/partials/theme-variables.html`)

Extracted from `head.html` into `templates/partials/theme-variables.html` and included via `{% include 'partials/theme-variables.html' %}`:

```html
{% if site_settings %}
<style>
:root {
    --color-primary: {{ site_settings.light_color_primary }};
    --color-secondary: {{ site_settings.light_color_secondary }};
    --color-accent: {{ site_settings.light_color_accent }};
    --color-background: {{ site_settings.light_color_background }};
    --color-surface: {{ site_settings.light_color_surface }};
}

html.dark {
    --color-primary: {{ site_settings.dark_color_primary }};
    --color-secondary: {{ site_settings.dark_color_secondary }};
    --color-accent: {{ site_settings.dark_color_accent }};
    --color-background: {{ site_settings.dark_color_background }};
    --color-surface: {{ site_settings.dark_color_surface }};
}
</style>
{% endif %}
```

### 1.4 Animations & Design System (`static/css/animations.css`)

All hardcoded hex and `rgb()`/`rgba()` color literals in `static/css/animations.css` have been replaced with `var(--color-*)` and `color-mix(in srgb, ...)` expressions:
- Glassmorphism tokens and classes (`.glass`, `.glass-strong`, `.glass-card`, plus `html.dark` overrides) derive from `--color-surface` and `--color-secondary`.
- Gradients (`.gradient-hero`, `.gradient-cta`, `.gradient-soft`, `.gradient-shimmer`, plus `html.dark` variants) derive from `--color-background`, `--color-surface`, `--color-accent`, `--color-primary`, and `--color-secondary`.
- Glows, hover shadows, scrollbars, and text selection (`pulse-soft`, `border-glow`, `.hover-lift:hover`, `.hover-glow:hover`, `::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb`, `::selection`, and `html.dark` variants) all reference CSS tokens dynamically so Admin color updates propagate everywhere without rebuilding CSS.

### 1.5 Template & Brand Hygiene

All templates under `templates/` have been audited and migrated:
- Zero arbitrary hex utility classes remain in `templates/**/*.html`.
- `templates/partials/header.html`: logo gradient migrated from `from-black to-accent` to `from-secondary to-accent`.
- `templates/index.html`, `templates/contact.html`, `templates/partials/footer.html`: decorative/surface/brand leaks migrated to `bg-whatsapp/10`, `text-whatsapp`, `bg-accent/10`, `bg-primary/10`, `text-primary`, `bg-surface/*`, and `shadow-secondary/10`.
- WhatsApp CTA buttons migrated to `--color-whatsapp` token classes (`bg-whatsapp`, `hover:bg-whatsapp/90`, `shadow-whatsapp/25`) across `base.html`, `empty_hero.html`, `featured_slider.html`, `product_card.html`, `favorites.html`, and `product_details.html`.
- `templates/partials/social_links.html`: Instagram (primary funnel) highlighted first as a prominent gradient pill (`bg-instagram-gradient text-white shadow-md shadow-instagram/30`) with label `إنستغرام`; WhatsApp uses `bg-whatsapp/10 text-whatsapp`; TikTok uses `bg-tiktok/10 text-tiktok`; Snapchat retains yellow styling.
- Standard Tailwind named colors are intentionally kept for status alerts (`red-*`, `emerald-*`, `blue-*`), star ratings (`amber-400`), and favorites (`rose-*`).

### 1.6 Django Admin (`catalog/admin.py`)

- `StoreSettingsAdmin` renders native HTML5 `<input type="color">` pickers synced two-ways with the hex `<input type="text">` inputs for all 10 color fields (zero third-party dependencies), while still submitting the hex text value under each field's exact `name` for Django validation.
- `_ColorPreviewAdminMixin` preserves read-only color swatch previews (`light_color_preview`, `dark_color_preview`) alongside both light and dark color fieldsets.
- Saving via Admin invalidates `StoreSettings` and currency rate caches.
- Metadata-only migration `0003_alter_storesettings_dark_color_accent_and_more.py` generated for the 10 `help_text` token annotations on `StoreSettings` (ready to apply to remote Supabase via `uv run python manage.py migrate`).

## 2. Final `@theme static` Token Set (`static/css/input.css`)

```css
@import "tailwindcss" source(none);

@source "../../templates";
@source "../../static/js";

@theme static {
    /* Fonts */
    --font-tajawal: "Tajawal", "sans-serif";
    --font-cairo: "Cairo", "sans-serif";
    --font-el-messiri: "El Messiri", "sans-serif";

    /* Core Color Tokens (light defaults matching StoreSettings) */
    --color-primary: #30669c;
    --color-secondary: #08121b;
    --color-accent: #e0801f;
    --color-background: #f6f1ee;
    --color-surface: #ffffff;

    /* Semantic Aliases */
    --color-text: var(--color-secondary);
    --color-text-muted: var(--color-secondary);
    --color-border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-secondary) 15%, transparent);
    --color-border-strong: var(--color-secondary);
    --color-focus: var(--color-accent);
    --color-focus-ring: var(--color-accent);
    --color-overlay: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-background) 80%, black);

    /* Status Colors */
    --color-success: #10b981;
    --color-warning: #f59e0b;
    --color-error: #ef4444;
    --color-info: #3b82f6;

    /* Brand Colors */
    --color-whatsapp: #25d366;
    --color-instagram: #e1306c;
    --color-instagram-start: #f58529;
    --color-instagram-mid: #dd2a7b;
    --color-instagram-end: #8134af;
    --color-tiktok: #010101;

    /* Rose Palette (wishlist/favorites) */
    --color-rose-50: #fff1f2;
    --color-rose-100: #ffe4e6;
    --color-rose-200: #fecdd3;
    --color-rose-300: #fda4af;
    --color-rose-400: #fb7185;
    --color-rose-500: #f43f5e;
    --color-rose-600: #e11d48;
    --color-rose-700: #be123c;
    --color-rose-800: #9f1239;
    --color-rose-900: #881337;
    --color-rose-950: #4c0519;
}

@utility bg-instagram-gradient {
    background-image: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        var(--color-instagram-start) 0%,
        var(--color-instagram-mid) 50%,
        var(--color-instagram-end) 100%
    );
}
```

## 3. Dark Mode Strategy (Temporarily Disabled, 1-Step Reversible)

**Current State:** Dark mode is **temporarily disabled** in the storefront UI while keeping all underlying data, admin controls, and CSS architecture intact for effortless re-enabling.

**What was disabled:**
1. `templates/partials/header.html`: desktop `#theme-toggle` and mobile `#theme-toggle-mobile` buttons commented out using Django template comments `{# ... #}` so they are not rendered in HTML.
2. `templates/base.html` and `templates/partials/js_imports.html`: `<script src="{% static 'js/theme.js' %}" defer></script>` tags commented out using `{# ... #}`.
3. `templates/partials/head.html`: `<meta name="theme-color">` set to light-only (`<meta name="theme-color" content="{{ site_settings.light_color_background|default:'#f6f1ee' }}" />`), with no `media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)"` attribute so dark-OS mobile browsers still receive the light theme bar.

**What remains intact:**
- All 5 `dark_color_*` database fields on `StoreSettings`.
- The dark color fieldset, native color pickers, and `dark_color_preview` swatches in `StoreSettingsAdmin`.
- The `html.dark` custom property block in `templates/partials/theme-variables.html`.
- All `html.dark` glass, gradient, scrollbar, and selection rules in `static/css/animations.css`.
- `static/js/theme.js` itself.

**How to re-enable dark mode later:**
1. Uncomment `#theme-toggle` and `#theme-toggle-mobile` in `templates/partials/header.html`.
2. Uncomment the `js/theme.js` `<script>` tag in `templates/base.html` (and `js_imports.html` if used).
3. Restore the `media="(prefers-color-scheme: light/dark)"` pair for `<meta name="theme-color">` in `templates/partials/head.html`.
4. Update the dark-mode-disabled assertions in `catalog/test_theme.py`.

## 5. Breaking Changes

| Change | Impact | Mitigation |
|--------|--------|------------|
| Extracted inline `<style>` from `head.html` | Templates relying on CSS variables continue working via `theme-variables.html` | Included in `head.html` |
| `surface`, `secondary`, `instagram`, `tiktok` added to `@theme` | Semantic and brand classes (`bg-surface`, `text-secondary`, `bg-instagram-gradient`, `bg-tiktok/10`) are generated cleanly | Compiled into `output.css` |
| Dark mode toggle & `theme.js` temporarily disabled | Storefront renders consistently in light mode | DB fields, Admin controls, and `html.dark` CSS kept intact for 1-step re-enable |
| Tailwind v4 `source(none)` + explicit `@source` | Non-template/JS files (such as `docs/`) are no longer scanned | All templates and JS files explicitly covered by `@source` |

**No breaking changes to:**
- `StoreSettings` model fields or singleton behavior (migration `0003` is metadata-only `help_text`)
- Existing Tailwind semantic class names (`primary`, `secondary`, `accent`, `background`, `surface`)
- Stored user preferences or admin data

---

## 6. Rollback Plan

If issues arise after deployment:

1. **Templates:** `git revert` the template commit(s) to restore previous markup or re-enable dark mode toggles.
2. **Static CSS:** `git revert` the static CSS commit(s) and run `npm run build` to regenerate `static/css/output.css`.
3. **Admin:** `git revert` the admin commit(s); migration `0003` only alters `help_text` metadata and can be rolled back safely without data loss.
4. **Verification:** Re-run `uv run python manage.py test` and `uv run python manage.py check`.
